description: This file contains JavaScript functions for handling CRM potentials, including setting return values, updating related lists, and managing address and contact information within the vtiger CRM system.

methods.name: set_return
methods.description: Sets parent name and ID in the opener window based on the link source.

methods.name: set_return_specific
methods.description: Sets potential name and ID in the opener window.

methods.name: add_data_to_relatedlist
methods.description: Updates the related contacts list via URL redirection.

methods.name: set_return_address
methods.description: Populates address fields in the opener window with provided address data.

methods.name: set_return_contact
methods.description: Sets potential and contact information in the opener window.

methods.name: set_return_todo
methods.description: Sets task parent name and ID in the opener window based on link source.
